name: assignment-no-duplicate
purpose: A reviewer who already holds an active assignment to a proposal cannot be assigned to it again (AssignmentValidity: no other active assignment to it).

given.text: Quorum is running with a published call, an officer, a chair, applicants and verified reviewers
proposal p1 has reached underReview with reviewers 0, 1 and 2 assigned

when.text: the officer assigns reviewer 0 to p1 a second time

then.text: the assignment is refused as already_assigned
